page_label: 说　明　书 4/9 页

paragraphs.zh: 本发明的有益效果在于：
paragraphs.en: The beneficial effects of the present invention are as follows:
paragraphs.notes: PROVENANCE: every zh field on this page was EXTRACTED FROM THE PDF'S OWN EMBEDDED TEXT LAYER, not read off pixels by a model. CN109678767A is born digital and all 11 pages carry a real text layer, so the Chinese characters here are the publication's own and are byte-exact, including full-width punctuation (， 。 ： ％ ～), the ideographic comma 、, the ASCII half-width parentheses and periods used inside chemical names and numbers, and the NO-BREAK SPACE U+00A0 that precedes some chemical names. The only normalisation applied is the removal of the column line-wrap newlines: the text layer breaks each paragraph across printed lines and those newlines have been closed up with NO character inserted, which is correct for Chinese wrapping. Nothing else was altered. The DRAWINGS carry no text layer at all and were read off the page image. This is the first line of body text on the page; nothing precedes it below the header rule. The scheme announced at the end of p05 does NOT continue onto this page - see the page-level note.

paragraphs.zh: 1.在制备2-氯-3-溴甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸甲酯的时候，以价格便宜的氢溴酸为溴化剂，降低了安全风险，提高了收率，降低了生产成本。
paragraphs.en: 1. In the preparation of methyl 2-chloro-3-bromomethyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoate, inexpensive hydrobromic acid is used as the brominating agent, which lowers the safety risk, raises the yield and lowers the production cost.
paragraphs.notes: 氢溴酸 = hydrobromic acid (aqueous HBr), not 溴素 (elemental bromine). The enumerator is an ASCII '1' followed by an ASCII full stop, not a full-width one.

paragraphs.zh: 2.在制备2-氯-3-(2,2,2-三氟乙氧基)甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸的时候，以在市场上易得的2,2,2-三氟乙醇为原料，使得该工艺具有工业化生产的可行性。
paragraphs.en: 2. In the preparation of 2-chloro-3-(2,2,2-trifluoroethoxy)methyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoic acid, 2,2,2-trifluoroethanol, which is readily obtainable on the market, is used as the raw material, which makes the process feasible for industrial-scale production.
paragraphs.notes: Both parentheses around '2,2,2-三氟乙氧基' are ASCII half-width in the text layer, and the locant commas are ASCII commas. Contrast the sister patent CN104292137A, which printed an asymmetric narrow-'(' / wide-'）' pair; this publication is symmetric and half-width throughout.

paragraphs.zh: 3.在环磺酮的合成的时候使用DMF代替乙腈，低毒代替高毒化学品，降低生产过程中中毒事故发生。
paragraphs.en: 3. In the synthesis of tembotrione, DMF is used in place of acetonitrile, a low-toxicity chemical replacing a high-toxicity one, reducing the occurrence of poisoning incidents during the production process.
paragraphs.notes: The target is named 环磺酮 throughout this publication (four characters: 环 磺 酮). Note this is NOT the four-character form 环磺草酮 used by CN104292137A; the character 草 is absent here. Both are Chinese common names for tembotrione. Recorded exactly as extracted. The step that this benefit refers to (DMF replacing acetonitrile) is not described on this page; Example 1 stops mid-step-2 at the page break.

paragraphs.zh: 4.不使用易燃、易爆、易潮解的甲醇钠为原料，降低了生产安全风险，更易于工业化生产。
paragraphs.en: 4. Sodium methoxide, which is flammable, explosive and readily deliquescent, is not used as a raw material, which lowers the production safety risk and makes industrial-scale production easier.
paragraphs.notes: 甲醇钠 = sodium methoxide (NaOMe). This is the last numbered benefit; the bold section heading 具体实施方式： follows it with no paragraph marker of its own.

Printed in BOLD at the left margin as a standalone section heading, set off by white space above and below, between the body of [0034] and the marker [0035]. It carries NO [00NN] marker of its own. Recorded here to preserve document order; downstream passes should treat it as a structural heading, not as paragraph content.

paragraphs.zh: 下面结合实施例对本方面做进一步详细的说明，但是此说明不会构成对本方面的限制。
paragraphs.en: The following gives a further detailed description of this aspect in conjunction with the examples, but this description shall not constitute a limitation on this aspect.
paragraphs.notes: 本方面 ('this aspect') appears TWICE and is verified in the extracted text layer as 方面, not 发明. The conventional boilerplate is 本发明 ('the present invention'). Translated literally as printed; the substitution is almost certainly a drafting slip but has NOT been corrected. Flagged in discrepancies.

paragraphs.zh: 本实施例提供一种环磺酮的合成工艺，包括以下步骤：
paragraphs.en: This example provides a process for the synthesis of tembotrione, comprising the following steps:
paragraphs.notes: This sentence establishes that everything from here to the end of the example is the INVENTION'S OWN worked route, not prior art. The two structures drawn on this page inherit that attribution.

paragraphs.zh: 1、2-氯-3-溴甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸甲酯的合成
paragraphs.notes: The step enumerator uses the ideographic comma 、 after the numeral ('1、'), the Chinese convention for a list marker, not a parenthesis. Same in [0041].

The marker [0039] is printed at the left margin with NO text on its line. Its content is DRAWING 1, the single structure occupying the full width of the column to its right (recorded in drawings[0]). The marker sits vertically centred beside the structure. Not damage and not an omission: this marker's whole content is a picture, which is why the text layer emits [0039] immediately followed by [0040].

paragraphs.zh: 将40g  2-氯-3-甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸甲酯(99.6％、0.152mol)，200ml二氯乙烷，1g偶氮二异丁腈(99％、0.006mol)，46g氢溴酸(48％、0.273mol)加入500ml反应瓶中，在75～80℃滴加20.6g双氧水(30％、0.182mol)，滴加完毕后继续反应，LC跟踪至反应完全，反应完全后分层，有机层水洗、浓缩，异丙醇进行重结晶、过滤、烘干得46.67g白色粉末，纯度99.0％，收率89％。
paragraphs.en: 40 g of methyl 2-chloro-3-methyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoate (99.6%, 0.152 mol), 200 ml of dichloroethane, 1 g of azobisisobutyronitrile (99%, 0.006 mol) and 46 g of hydrobromic acid (48%, 0.273 mol) are charged into a 500 ml reaction flask, and 20.6 g of hydrogen peroxide (30%, 0.182 mol) is added dropwise at 75 to 80 degrees C; after the addition is complete the reaction is continued and is followed by LC until the reaction is complete; after completion the layers are separated, the organic layer is washed with water and concentrated, recrystallised from isopropanol, filtered and dried to give 46.67 g of a white powder, purity 99.0%, yield 89%.
paragraphs.notes: Character-level detail preserved from the text layer: after '将40g' there is a NO-BREAK SPACE (U+00A0) followed by an ordinary space before the chemical name; the same doubled gap occurs in [0043]. The separator inside every parenthesis is the ideographic comma 、, not a full-width comma, so the purity and the mole figure are joined by '、' - reproduced exactly. 二氯乙烷 is printed WITHOUT a locant: it reads only 'dichloroethane', never '1,2-二氯乙烷', and the 1,2-isomer has NOT been inferred. 偶氮二异丁腈 = AIBN (radical initiator). 双氧水 = hydrogen peroxide, the oxidant that regenerates Br from HBr. 纯度 = purity, 收率 = yield. Reagent stoichiometry sanity check (not a correction, just a legibility confirmation): 40 g x 99.6% / 0.152 mol = 262 g/mol, matching methyl 2-chloro-3-methyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoate, so the digits are read correctly.

paragraphs.zh: 2、2-氯-3-(2,2,2-三氟乙氧基)甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸的合成
paragraphs.notes: The step-2 product is named as the free ACID (苯甲酸), not an ester. Drawing 2 at [0042] draws the free acid, so heading and drawing agree.
As with [0039], the marker [0042] is printed at the left margin with NO text on its line. Its content is DRAWING 2, the single structure to its right (recorded in drawings[1]).

paragraphs.zh: 将30g  2-氯-3-溴甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸甲酯(99.0％、0.0869mol)，18g碳酸钾(99％、0.1289mol)，0.9g三乙烯二胺(99％、0.0079mol)，200ml四氢呋喃，10.5g  2,2,2-三氟乙醇(99％、0.1039mol)加入500ml反应瓶中，在75～80℃进行反应，LC跟踪至反应完全，反应完毕后过滤，滤液浓缩。往剩余物里6g氢氧化钠(99％、0.1485mol)，200ml水，在70～75℃进行碱解，LC跟踪至反应完全，反应完全后滴加盐酸酸化，过滤，洗涤，烘干得27.6g白色
paragraphs.en: 30 g of methyl 2-chloro-3-bromomethyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoate (99.0%, 0.0869 mol), 18 g of potassium carbonate (99%, 0.1289 mol), 0.9 g of triethylenediamine (99%, 0.0079 mol), 200 ml of tetrahydrofuran and 10.5 g of 2,2,2-trifluoroethanol (99%, 0.1039 mol) are charged into a 500 ml reaction flask and reacted at 75 to 80 degrees C, followed by LC until the reaction is complete; after the reaction is finished the mixture is filtered and the filtrate is concentrated. Into the residue, 6 g of sodium hydroxide (99%, 0.1485 mol) and 200 ml of water, alkaline hydrolysis is carried out at 70 to 75 degrees C, followed by LC until the reaction is complete; after completion hydrochloric acid is added dropwise to acidify, and the mixture is filtered, washed and dried to give 27.6 g of white
paragraphs.notes: TRUNCATED AT THE PAGE BREAK. The paragraph ends mid-phrase on the last printed line as '烘干得27.6g白色' ('dried to give 27.6 g of white'), with the noun and any purity/yield figures continuing on p07. No character is missing from what is printed here; the sentence simply does not finish on this page. GRAMMAR: '往剩余物里6g氢氧化钠...，200ml水' has NO verb - the expected 加入 ('add') is absent between 里 and 6g. The English keeps the same defective construction rather than repairing it. 三乙烯二胺 = triethylenediamine, i.e. DABCO / 1,4-diazabicyclo[2.2.2]octane, here a catalytic phase-transfer / nucleophilic catalyst at ~9 mol%; translated literally as printed rather than as its trade abbreviation. 碱解 = alkaline hydrolysis (saponification of the methyl ester to the acid), which is why the [0041] heading and drawing 2 both show the free acid. Two NO-BREAK SPACE + space gaps occur, after '30g' and after '10.5g'. Sanity check on legibility only: 30 g x 99.0% / 0.0869 mol = 342 g/mol, matching the bromomethyl methyl ester of drawing 1, so the digits are read correctly.

structures.position_in_drawing: 1st and only structure; occupies the column to the right of the marker [0039]
substituents: C(=O)OCH3 at C1 (drawn as a ring bond to a carbonyl carbon bearing a doubled bond to O drawn up-left, and a single bond to the O of the label H3CO written to the left, so the alkyl group on the ester oxygen is methyl)
Cl at C2 (label Cl on a plain bond drawn straight up from the ring vertex adjacent to C1)
CH2Br at C3 (ring bond up-right to an unlabelled vertex, then a bond up to the label Br; the unlabelled vertex is an implicit CH2, so the group is bromomethyl, not Br bonded directly to the ring)
SO2CH3 at C4 (ring bond down-right to a labelled S carrying a doubled bond to an O drawn above it and a doubled bond to an O drawn below it, then a single bond right to the label CH3)
H at C5 (unsubstituted ring vertex, bottom)
H at C6 (unsubstituted ring vertex, lower left)
structures.name: methyl 2-chloro-3-(bromomethyl)-4-(methanesulfonyl)benzoate

drawings.notes: Clean vector line art, not a scan of a scan: every bond terminus and every atom label is sharp at 5x magnification, so no substituent position on this drawing is in doubt. The ring is drawn as an explicit Kekule hexagon with inner double-bond lines on the C1-C2, C3-C4 and C5-C6 edges. Numbering used in the substituents list above is assigned with the ester carbon as C1 and then proceeding around the ring in the direction that reaches Cl first, which is the direction the printed name in [0038] uses; the RELATIVE arrangement read off the drawing is what matters and is: ester and Cl adjacent, Cl and CH2Br adjacent, CH2Br and SO2CH3 adjacent, two adjacent unsubstituted vertices completing the ring. THIS IS A LONE PRODUCT STRUCTURE, NOT A SCHEME. There is no arrow, no starting material and no reagent text anywhere in the drawing; the reagents live only in the prose of [0040]. It is the product of step 1 of Example 1, i.e. an intermediate on the INVENTION'S OWN route (established by [0037] '本实施例提供一种环磺酮的合成工艺'), and is in no sense prior art. The drawing carries no text layer; it was read off the page image.

structures.position_in_drawing: 1st and only structure; occupies the column to the right of the marker [0042]
substituents: COOH at C1 (ring bond up-left to a carbonyl carbon bearing a doubled bond to O drawn straight up, and a single bond left to the label HO, so a free carboxylic acid and not an ester)
Cl at C2 (label Cl on a plain bond drawn up-right from the ring vertex adjacent to C1)

CH2OCH2CF3 at C3 (a single plain bond drawn horizontally right from the ring vertex to the condensed label 'CH2OCH2CF3'; the internal connectivity ring-CH2-O-CH2-CF3 is read from the label string, since no bonds are drawn inside it)
SO2CH3 at C4 (ring bond down-right to a labelled S carrying a doubled bond to an O drawn up-right and a doubled bond to an O drawn down-left, then a single bond down-right to the label CH3)
H at C5 (unsubstituted ring vertex, bottom left)
H at C6 (unsubstituted ring vertex, left)
structures.name: 2-chloro-4-(methanesulfonyl)-3-[(2,2,2-trifluoroethoxy)methyl]benzoic acid

drawings.notes: Clean vector line art; every label sharp at 3x magnification. The hexagon here is drawn flat-top rather than point-left as in drawing 1, but the substitution pattern read off it is the same relative arrangement with CH2OCH2CF3 in place of CH2Br and COOH in place of CO2CH3: acid and Cl adjacent, Cl and CH2OCH2CF3 adjacent, CH2OCH2CF3 and SO2CH3 adjacent, two adjacent unsubstituted vertices. Kekule inner lines on the C1-C6, C2-C3 and C4-C5 edges. ONE READING CAVEAT recorded for honesty: the trifluoroethoxymethyl group is given as a CONDENSED TEXT LABEL, 'CH2OCH2CF3', with subscripted 2, 2 and 3. Its atom-to-atom connectivity is therefore inferred from the standard left-to-right reading of a condensed formula rather than from drawn bonds. That reading is unambiguous here (there is only one way to parse CH2-O-CH2-CF3 as a monovalent substituent) and it agrees with the printed name in [0041], so confidence is high, but the distinction between a drawn skeleton and a condensed label is noted because it is the kind of thing a later reader must be able to audit. AGAIN NOT A SCHEME: no arrow, no starting material, no reagent text. It is the product of step 2 of Example 1 and belongs to the INVENTION'S OWN route per [0037]. The drawing carries no text layer; it was read off the page image.

discrepancies.what: Both drawings on this page show only the PRODUCT of their step. Every reagent, solvent, catalyst, temperature and workup for those steps is written in the prose and drawn nowhere, and neither starting material is drawn.
discrepancies.drawing_says: Drawing 1 ([0039]) is the bare structure of methyl 2-chloro-3-(bromomethyl)-4-(methanesulfonyl)benzoate with no arrow and no annotation. Drawing 2 ([0042]) is the bare structure of 2-chloro-4-(methanesulfonyl)-3-[(2,2,2-trifluoroethoxy)methyl]benzoic acid, likewise with no arrow and no annotation.
discrepancies.text_says: [0040] supplies the whole of step 1 (substrate methyl 2-chloro-3-methyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoate, dichloroethane, AIBN, HBr 48%, H2O2 30%, 75 to 80 C, isopropanol recrystallisation, 46.67 g, 99.0% purity, 89% yield) and [0043] supplies the whole of step 2 (substrate the bromomethyl ester, K2CO3, triethylenediamine, THF, 2,2,2-trifluoroethanol, 75 to 80 C, then NaOH / water saponification at 70 to 75 C, HCl acidification, 27.6 g). Reported per the rule requiring reagents written but not drawn to be flagged: a downstream pass must take the reaction conditions from the prose, because the drawings carry none.

discrepancies.what: No conflict, recorded as a positive cross-check: each drawing agrees exactly with the compound name in its own step heading.
discrepancies.drawing_says: Drawing 1 reads 2-Cl / 3-CH2Br / 4-SO2CH3 on a benzoate whose ester oxygen bears a methyl. Drawing 2 reads 2-Cl / 3-CH2OCH2CF3 / 4-SO2CH3 on a free benzoic acid.
discrepancies.text_says: [0038] names methyl 2-chloro-3-bromomethyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoate and [0041] names 2-chloro-3-(2,2,2-trifluoroethoxy)methyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoic acid. Both match their drawings substituent for substituent and position for position, including the ester-vs-acid distinction. There is nothing on this page that a drawing contradicts.

discrepancies.what: Text-vs-text. The boilerplate sentence introducing the examples says 'this aspect' where the standard phrasing is 'the present invention', twice in one sentence.
discrepancies.drawing_says: n/a - the discrepancy is between prose and convention, not with any drawing
discrepancies.text_says: [0035] reads '下面结合实施例对本方面做进一步详细的说明，但是此说明不会构成对本方面的限制。' The characters 本方面 are what the embedded text layer contains, so this is not a reading error on this pass; compare [0030] on the same page, which uses the normal 本发明. Transcribed and translated verbatim; not corrected.

discrepancies.what: Text-vs-text. The chlorinated solvent in step 1 is named without a locant.
discrepancies.drawing_says: n/a - solvent does not appear in any drawing
discrepancies.text_says: [0040] says only '200ml二氯乙烷' (dichloroethane), never '1,2-二氯乙烷'. 1,2-dichloroethane is the solvent this would conventionally be, but the isomer is not stated anywhere on the page and has NOT been inferred into the transcription or the translation.

discrepancies.what: Naming variation between this publication and the target's Chinese common name as it appears elsewhere in the same family of documents. Recorded so a downstream name-matching pass does not treat the two spellings as two compounds.
discrepancies.text_says: [0033] and [0037] both name the target 环磺酮 (three characters). The sister publication CN104292137A uses 环磺草酮 (four characters, with 草). Both denote tembotrione. The form on this page is verified from the embedded text layer, so the shorter spelling is what this document actually prints.

discrepancies.what: PDF text-layer artifact that is NOT visible on the page and must not be transcribed as content.
discrepancies.drawing_says: The rendered page image shows exactly one footer, the page number '6' centred at the bottom, and one header line: 'CN 109678767 A' at the left, '说 明 书' centred, '4/9 页' at the right.
